answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lantern of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Each submission hangs on the ember of a task receipt, and the ferrous is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, revoked by a single upheld challenge, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
